description: Complete typed outbound Messages API built on FEAT-001's HttpClient and error classes. Adds src/types/messages.ts (request/response types), src/resources/messages.ts (MessagesResource exposed as client.messages), tests for the HTTP core AND the messages senders (mock fetch, fake timers), and documentation updates (README Usage + status, CHANGELOG). DEPENDS ON FEAT-001 — do not start until FEAT-001 is completed. Independent of no other work.
steps: Add src/types/messages.ts: SendMessageResponse = { messaging_product: 'whatsapp'; contacts: { input: string; wa_id: string }[]; messages: { id: string; message_status?: string }[] }. Define per-type payload/option types: text (body + preview_url?), media as a discriminated union MediaSource = { id: string } | { link: string } extended per kind with caption? (image/video/document) and filename? (document); location { latitude; longitude; name?; address? }; a reasonable typed Contact subset (name { formatted_name; first_name?; last_name?; ... }, phones?, emails?) with JSDoc noting omissions; template { name; language: { code: string }; components?: TemplateComponent[] } where TemplateComponent models header/body/button parameters structurally; interactive button payload (body text, up to 3 reply buttons { type:'reply'; reply:{ id; title } }, header?, footer?) and list payload (body, button label, sections of rows { id; title; description? }, header?, footer?); reaction { message_id; emoji }; mark-as-read body. Respect exactOptionalPropertyTypes and use `import type` for type-only imports.

Add src/resources/messages.ts: `class MessagesResource` constructed with the client's bound request function and a config accessor providing the default phoneNumberId. A private helper resolves the phone number id (per-call override OR config default) and throws WhatsAppValidationError if neither is set, then POSTs to `${phoneNumberId}/messages`. A private sender builds the common envelope { messaging_product:'whatsapp', recipient_type:'individual', to, type, [type]: payload } and returns the parsed SendMessageResponse. Implement: sendText(to, text, opts?) with preview_url; sendImage/sendVideo/sendAudio/sendDocument/sendSticker taking the MediaSource union (+caption/filename where valid) with a runtime guard throwing WhatsAppValidationError when neither id nor link is present; sendLocation(to, {latitude,longitude,name?,address?}); sendContacts(to, contacts); sendTemplate(to, {name, language, components?}); sendInteractiveButtons(to, {body, buttons, header?, footer?}) throwing WhatsAppValidationError when buttons.length > 3; sendInteractiveList(to, {body, button, sections, header?, footer?}); sendReaction(to, {messageId, emoji}) building { reaction: { message_id, emoji } } and documenting that an empty emoji removes the reaction; markAsRead(messageId) POSTing { messaging_product:'whatsapp', status:'read', message_id }. Throw WhatsAppValidationError on empty `to` for sends. Add a small helper to read the first WAMID from a SendMessageResponse while keeping the raw response as the return value.

Edit src/index.ts: add a lazily-memoized `get messages(): MessagesResource` on WhatsAppClient (instantiate once, bound to the internal request + a phoneNumberId accessor). Re-export all public message types and the MessagesResource type and SendMessageResponse from the barrel. Preserve every existing export and behavior.

Add tests/http.test.ts: stub global fetch (vi.stubGlobal) and assert request URL (`${baseUrl}/${path}`), method, headers (Authorization bearer, content-type for JSON bodies) and serialized body. Assert error mapping: mocked 400, 401, 429, 500 responses carrying a WhatsApp error envelope map to the correct typed error (WhatsAppApiError / WhatsAppAuthenticationError) with code/subcode/fbtraceId populated. Assert a 429 with Retry-After retries then succeeds using vi.useFakeTimers so no real sleep occurs. Assert a non-retryable 4xx (e.g. 400) does NOT retry (fetch called once). Assert a network error and a timeout surface WhatsAppRequestError (isTimeout true for timeout). Keep deterministic.

Add tests/messages.test.ts: stub global fetch and, for each sender, assert the POST goes to `.../{phoneNumberId}/messages`, method POST, correct headers, and the exact request body (messaging_product + recipient_type + to + type + type object), and that it returns the parsed SendMessageResponse and exposes the WAMID. Cover the per-call phoneNumberId override, boundary validations (interactive buttons > 3 throws WhatsAppValidationError, media with neither id nor link throws, empty `to` throws), sendReaction removal via empty emoji, and the markAsRead body shape { messaging_product:'whatsapp', status:'read', message_id }.

Update README.md Usage: construct the client with accessToken + phoneNumberId, then show `await client.messages.sendText('15551234567', 'Hello')`, a sendTemplate example, and a sendInteractiveButtons example. Change the status note so outbound messaging is marked implemented while webhooks, media upload, and template management remain pending. Update CHANGELOG.md under [Unreleased] > Added with an entry describing the HTTP core (timeout/retry/backoff, typed errors) and the typed Messages API. Keep Prettier formatting (printWidth 100).
acceptance_criteria: src/types/messages.ts and src/resources/messages.ts exist and compile under the strict tsconfig.
client.messages is available, lazily instantiated, and every documented sender method exists with the correct typed signature.

Each sender produces a body with messaging_product:'whatsapp', recipient_type:'individual', to, the correct type, and the type-specific object, POSTed to {phoneNumberId}/messages, and returns the parsed SendMessageResponse with the WAMID accessible.
Boundary misuse (empty to, > 3 interactive buttons, media without id or link) throws WhatsAppValidationError, not a bare Error.

New tests in tests/http.test.ts and tests/messages.test.ts cover URL/method/headers/body per message type, error mapping for 400/401/429/500 with code/subcode/fbtrace_id, a 429+Retry-After retry-then-success with fake timers, a non-retryable 4xx with no retry, a network/timeout error, and all boundary validations — and they are deterministic (no real sleeping).
README Usage shows real messages examples and the status note reflects outbound messaging implemented; CHANGELOG has the [Unreleased] > Added entry.
The 6 existing client tests still pass and no runtime dependency was added.
Running `pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run test && pnpm run build` succeeds.
verification: Run `pnpm run typecheck` and confirm no type errors.
Run `pnpm run lint` and confirm no lint errors.
Run `pnpm run format:check` (run `pnpm run format` first if needed) and confirm formatting passes.
Run `pnpm run test` and confirm all tests pass: the 6 existing client tests, the new HTTP tests, and the new messages tests.
Run `pnpm run build` and confirm tsup produces the ESM + CJS bundles and type declarations without errors.
findings: Public surface added for later steps (all re-exported from src/index.ts barrel): MessagesResource (class) plus message types SendMessageResponse, TextMessageOptions, MediaSource, CaptionedMedia, DocumentMedia, LocationPayload, Contact/ContactName/ContactPhone/ContactEmail, TemplatePayload/TemplateComponent/TemplateParameter, InteractiveButtonsPayload/InteractiveListPayload/InteractiveListSection/InteractiveListRow/InteractiveReplyButton/InteractiveTextHeader, ReactionPayload. WhatsAppClient now exposes a lazily-memoized `get messages(): MessagesResource` bound to `(options) => this.http.request(options)` and `() => this.config.phoneNumberId`. MessagesResource is constructed as `new MessagesResource(requestFn, phoneNumberIdAccessor)` where requestFn is `<T>(RequestOptions) => Promise<T>`; it is defined in src/resources/messages.ts, which also exports a standalone helper `getFirstMessageId(response): string | undefined` and the RequestFn/PhoneNumberIdAccessor types. Senders: sendText(to, text, {previewUrl?}), sendImage/sendVideo(to, CaptionedMedia), sendAudio/sendSticker(to, MediaSource), sendDocument(to, DocumentMedia), sendLocation(to, LocationPayload), sendContacts(to, Contact[]), sendTemplate(to, TemplatePayload), sendInteractiveButtons(to, InteractiveButtonsPayload), sendInteractiveList(to, InteractiveListPayload), sendReaction(to, {messageId, emoji}), markAsRead(messageId, phoneNumberId?). All senders POST to `${phoneNumberId}/messages` and return the parsed SendMessageResponse. Each sender builds { messaging_product:'whatsapp', recipient_type:'individual', to, type, [type]: payload }; markAsRead posts { messaging_product:'whatsapp', status:'read', message_id }. Validation (WhatsAppValidationError) is thrown SYNCHRONOUSLY (not a rejected promise): empty `to`, missing phoneNumberId (no per-call override and none configured), >3 interactive buttons, and media with neither id nor link. An empty emoji in sendReaction removes the reaction. Interactive button/list payloads use friendly inputs: buttons as {id,title}[] (mapped to {type:'reply',reply:{id,title}}), header as a plain string (wrapped to {type:'text',text}), footer as a plain string. Tests: tests/http.test.ts (9) and tests/messages.test.ts (18) added; mock fetch via vi.stubGlobal returning a FRESH Response per call (a Response body is single-use, so reuse across retries throws 'Body is unusable'), use injectable HttpClient delay or vi.useFakeTimers + vi.runAllTimersAsync/advanceTimersByTimeAsync for retry/backoff. Full gate green: 33 tests (6 client + 9 http + 18 messages), typecheck/lint/format:check/build all pass; zero runtime deps unchanged.
